items.title: China AI Spotlight · Piotech — how the thin-film leader earns its keep, with domestic tools past 50%
items.summary: Third-quarter revenue of CNY 2.308bn was a quarterly record and non-GAAP net profit of CNY 561m more than doubled from the second quarter. Gross margin reached 42.47%, up from 35.0% for all of 2025. The headline CNY 2.431bn of nine-month net profit is mostly a CNY 1.616bn fair-value gain on listed stakes; the operating business doubled on a non-GAAP basis. Today's limit-up was the sector, not the company: reports that domestic tools took more than half of purchases on the third-phase line of a leading memory maker, SEMI's USD 149bn 2026 front-end forecast and China's first equipment quality standard all landed on the same day. The problem is the price: 57 times trailing earnings and about 2% below the highest analyst target.
items.text: Piotech 파이오텍 拓荆科技

items.title: China AI Daily Report · November 27
items.summary: A State Council executive meeting at midday, with its reference to a 'stabilisation fund' role for Central Huijin, turned the whole A-share market around. Shanghai rose 3.73% to 3,606.49 and reclaimed 3,600; ChiNext jumped 11.61% and the STAR 50 15.07%, the largest ChiNext day since 8 October 2024 and the STAR 50's third-best on record. Turnover rose CNY 682bn to CNY 1.9998tn, with 5,382 stocks up against 181 down. All eleven of our names rose: Zhongji Innolight +19.98%, limit-ups for Eoptolink, Piotech, VeriSilicon, Shengyi and GigaDevice, Cambricon +18.68%, Hygon +18.05%, Montage +15.69%, SMIC +15.38% and CXMT +12.97%. Zhongji Innolight led the market on both turnover (CNY 33.397bn) and main-fund inflow (CNY 3.769bn).

items.title: China AI Spotlight · Eoptolink — a quarter lost to floods, a capacity surge held for Q4
items.summary: Q3 revenue of CNY 10.940bn (+80.3%) and net profit of CNY 3.843bn (+61.2%) look like a stall until you see what caused them: flooding in Thailand pushed September shipments into October. The company has grown production capacity 1.9x in a year but could only run 38% of it because materials were short. Q4 is where that slack turns into revenue. We take apart the numbers of a stock that rose 4.26% today while chips fell — 97.92% overseas revenue, a concentrated customer base, tariffs and the yuan included.

Shanghai rose 0.01% to 3,476.88, its first gain in two sessions, but it could not reclaim 3,500; the STAR 50 fell another 1.36%. CXMT fell 2.71% and was the market's largest target of main-fund selling at CNY 795m, while SMIC dropped 4.51%. The index was flat but 3,642 stocks fell.

items.title: US Markets Spotlight · META — Record ads, negative free cash flow
items.summary: Third-quarter revenue of $64.6 billion (+26%), average price per ad up 14% and 3.64 billion daily users — by the numbers, a record quarter. The same quarter produced negative free cash flow of $2.12 billion, the first in more than a decade, and operating margin fell from 41% to 20%. Capital spending for 2026 is guided to $135-145 billion, roughly double 2025. On the 25th the stock reversed from -3.7% to +3.4% on Amazon talks over its Muse shopping agent and a $4.5 billion Meta-backed data centre loan, while JPMorgan cut its target to $775 from $940.

items.summary: Wall Street gave back almost all of an early slide. The S&P 500 was down 3.2% at its low, the Nasdaq 4.6% and almost 1,100 points on the Dow, and the session ended with the S&P down 0.25%, the Nasdaq down 0.62% and the Dow up 0.33%; the SOX fell nearly 8% intraday and closed down 0.65%. October PCE printed at 3.8%, a three-year high, third-quarter GDP was revised up to 4.3%, and Washington proposed tariffs of up to 20-40% on 14 trading partners. Nvidia fell 3.91%, while Meta rose 3.40%.

items.title: China AI Spotlight · CXMT — how far does an 89.5% gross margin go?
items.summary: Q3 revenue of CNY 118.714bn (+613.2%), net profit of CNY 54.435bn and an 89.53% gross margin — the highest in the industry, above Micron's 86.8% and SK hynix's 86.0%. Yet the stock fell 7.34% on the day and was the market's largest target of main-fund selling. In four months since listing, its market value has gone from CNY 3.28tn to CNY 2.2809tn. Here is what sits between a market selling the cycle and a company that has already sold its 2027 output.

items.summary: One day was enough to undo Monday. Semiconductors rolled over again, leaving the S&P 500 down 0.50% at 7,201.09 and the Nasdaq down 1.48% at 23,733.54. Nvidia fell 5.86%, handing back about half of its 31% gain, Micron lost 11.0% and AMD 8.9%, and the SOX dropped 7.88% with all thirty members lower. items.summary: Jensen Huang is back at Nvidia, and the AI trade came back with him. The board reinstated him 12 days after his resignation, Nvidia jumped 31.48%, and the Nasdaq rose 6.51% for its best day since April 2025.
